class.name: InventoryItemFragment
class.brief_description: One piece of what an item is; extend it to give items data or behaviour of your own.
class.description: An [InventoryItemDefinition] carries no behaviour itself: whether an item has a quick bar icon, can be equipped, starts with stats or has a body in the world is decided by the fragments it lists. GFGD ships [InventoryFragmentEquippableItem], [InventoryFragmentQuickBarIcon], [InventoryFragmentSetStats] and [InventoryFragmentPickup]; a game adds its own by extending this class in a script and finds them with [method InventoryItemDefinition.find_fragment_by_class]. Fragments are shared by every instance of the item, so they hold definition data only. Per-instance state belongs on the [InventoryItemInstance] (stat tags and data).

method.name: _on_instance_created
method.description: Called on the server for every new instance of the item, before any inventory or client knows about it - the place to set its starting stat tags or data.
